tc_updates.title: Login with OTP
tc_updates.reason: Requirement now requires OTP to expire after 60s, but this TC's expected result assumes no expiry.

diff.before: OTP remains valid until manually resent.

tc_gaps.suggested_scope: Verify login fails when OTP is submitted after the 60s expiry window.

questions.question: Does the 60s OTP expiry apply to the password-reset flow too, or only login?
questions.why_it_matters: If it also applies to password-reset, TC-140 and TC-141 need the same update.
